name: Seraphina Graciani
original_name: セラフィナ グラシャーニ
source:
A tomboyish girl who barged into the office and forced her way into becoming his assistant.
She’s a third-year student at the Academy.
—However, being with Hayate is more important to her!
Because she keeps skipping lectures, her graduation is now in jeopardy.

[b]“A huge case, just like the ones in mystery novels, where I can make full use of Senpai’s talent and my skills!”[/b]
